prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are consistently helpful, as both completed tests won.
sign_in, copy changes showed no clear effect across both tested changes.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for most other change kinds, including adoption copy and adoption redesign where only one of two tests won.
Most tested changes resulted in no clear effect, and non-significant changes should not be treated as effective even if noise-corrected numbers lean positive.
Predictions consistently overestimated non-winning tests, particularly in early rounds where large positive lifts were expected.
Predictions underestimated winning tests, predicting modest gains (+0.5% to +2.4%) for changes that achieved larger noise-corrected wins (+3.6% to +6.7%).

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] home_intro_two_column_redesign: Redesign the final home_intro screen into a structured two-column layout highlighting pet desktop controls and companion readiness. (why: Finish has the lowest completion conversion rate (66.5%) with long mean duration (5815s), and users report confusion about pet controls after onboarding.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_carousel_flow: Transform pet selection on the pick_friend screen into an interactive carousel flow showing pet personalities and traits. (why: Adoption conversion is 77.2% with long completion times (89s median / 1017s mean), and interactive visual selection reduces friction.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] reorder_sign_in_after_adoption: Move the sign_in step to occur right after pet adoption selection instead of before choosing a pet. (why: Sign-in conversion is low (72.9%). Moving sign-in after pet selection builds emotional attachment before asking for authentication.)
3: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_tip_carousel: Add a tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining pet desktop interactions while assets load. (why: Wait info changes have proven consistently effective in earlier tests, helping engage users during the 201s median wait time.)
4: [home, notification] waiting_desktop_completion_notification: Enable system notification alerts on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet finishes generating. (why: Waiting step mean duration is very high (2336s), indicating users step away while waiting and need notifications to resume.)
5: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_visibility_hint: Add a prominent taskbar hint component on home_intro clarifying where the pet app icon resides. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries about missing pets on desktop and confusion around pet visibility after setup.)
6: [adoption, incentive] adoption_certificate_badge_incentive: Display a playful companion badge component on adoption_certificate to celebrate adoption completion. (why: Adoption conversion is 77.2% with long mean completion time (1017s); visual rewards increase completion momentum.)
7: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_reassurance_copy: Update choose_path headline and body text to clarify that chosen paths can be adjusted anytime later. (why: Choose path step has a long mean time (514s), suggesting users hesitate out of fear of making a permanent choice.)
8: [sign_in, layout] sign_in_centered_layout: Switch the sign_in screen to a focused centered layout emphasizing account synchronization benefits. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and 8 support emails reported lost pets/resets due to account sign-in confusion.)

scores.note: Finish step has highest drop rate and strong support signal, but past finish redesigns performed poorly.
Adoption has long completion times and positive early flow test results, but requires building a new carousel UI.
Sign-in reordering showed strong negative impact in previous testing despite strong logical premise.
Wait_info changes on home are consistently effective across tests, backed by 201s wait time metric.
High mean wait duration indicates drop-off, but notification changes previously showed slightly negative lift.
Target step drops 33.5% with heavy support email volume; finish hint previously delivered solid positive lift.
Visual incentives may shorten adoption friction, but evidence base for badge additions is unproven.
Cheap config-only copy change targeting path hesitation, though copy changes generally yield minor lift.
Strong support mail alignment on sign-in issues, but sign_in layout changes showed near zero past effect.
